sentences.text: For this floating-rate loan to an individual sanctioned on 2026-01-01, the applicable direction says a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges. [R1, E6]

The in-force rules that mention a levy either say pre-payment charges are not permitted for this case or, for other cases, that any pre-payment charges must follow the UCB’s approved policy; they do not give a specific rate for this case. [R1, R2, E12, E13]

missing.searched: Looked for a prescribed pre-payment charge rate or formula for floating-rate loans to individuals sanctioned in 2026 under the UCB directions; the cited rules only state that no charge shall be levied for this case.
